name: Nam Securities Limited
about: Nam Securities Limited provides securities trading and brokerage services primarily in India. It is involved in the trading of shares and mutual funds, as well as provision of depository services. The company also offers future and options advisory, investment banking, retirement planning services, as well as initial public offerings, share buy-backs, and rights issues services. In addition, it provides BIDWEL, a mobile trading application. Nam Securities Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in New Delhi, India.
